About this roadmap

The ground-up rebuild of UCSD's UCPath HR automation, as a tree. Phases 0–2 are complete — the platform is built and proven; Phase 3 migrates the 13 remaining legacy workflows one at a time and entered at separations; legacy stays the sole production authority until one all-at-once cutover. Every box shows what it builds (by layer, filled when built) and what it needs — select one for detail, hover to light up what it unlocks.

completeactiveneeds youavailable nextlockedproposedwon't build / deferred

Phases stack on the time spine at the left; each phase's tasks fan out to its right, sub-tasks beneath their parent. The squares inside a box are its features — one per feature, coloured by layer, filled when built — so a box reads "3 of 5 built, the missing two are wiring": FEReact only · BEBFF / kernel · BOTHvertical slice · WIREconnecting two halves that exist · DOCS · PROOFlive run / measurement.

Click a box for its detail; hover to light up what it needs and what it unlocks (green when the prerequisite is met, dashed when open; amber = an act only you can take). Drag to pan; zoom with the controls; Esc closes this panel.
